summary: Cheetah Net Supply Chain Service Inc. filed an 8-K on September 15, 2026 disclosing a Membership Interest Purchase Agreement to acquire all outstanding equity of JoyPak Supply LLC, a Nevada consumer-products seller, from Newland Asset Management LLC and Redwing Capital LLC. Aggregate purchase price is $788,000: $88,000 initial payment within two business days and $700,000 at closing, expected on or about October 15, 2026 and no later than four weeks after signing. JoyPak becomes a wholly owned subsidiary; the initial payment is refundable without setoff if the deal terminates other than through Cheetah's breach. Watch closing conditions, due-diligence termination rights, and any financing or Nasdaq compliance overhang.
